title: THE GOUT MOBILE // VALYRIAN NITRO CHARGE
narrative: Prince Doran sits in his ebony wheelchair beside the reflecting pools. Darkstar approaches with a drawn dagger. Doran sighs, flips open the armrest, and hits a red toggle switch. Two twin Valyrian steel exhaust pipes roar with wildfire flames. The wheelchair accelerates from 0 to 60 in 1.4 seconds, leaving twin trails of burning rubber across the marble courtyard. 'You thought gout made me immobile?' Doran cackles over the engine roar. 'I have four hundred horsepower of Dornish engineering!'

options.text: Drift through the Water Gardens to crush the overripe blood oranges.
Tow Quentyn Martell behind the wheelchair on dragon skis.
Race to Griffin's Roost to negotiate with Aegon's war elephants.
